heroSubtitle: A comprehensive system covering the full inpatient lifecycle from admission to discharge, including bed management, medications, procedures, patient accounts, and health insurance.
heroBoxDesc: Real-time occupancy map with transfer and discharge alerts.
visionTitle: How Does the Inpatient System Transform Your Healthcare Facility?
visionDesc: The system connects bed management, treatment, medications, and patient accounts in one platform, ensuring billing accuracy, cost transparency, and improved healthcare quality.

features.title: Admission, Discharge & Transfer (ADT)
features.desc: Complete ADT management from bed and room assignment at admission through inter-department transfers to final discharge, with discharge reasons and medical reports.

features.title: Inpatient Medical Record & Doctor Orders
features.desc: Comprehensive inpatient record with diagnoses, doctor orders, nursing notes, and treatment protocols, with a complete timeline of every procedure during the stay.

features.title: Medication & Medical Supplies Tracking
features.desc: Real-time tracking of medication and medical supply consumption per patient, linked to pharmacy inventory with automatic patient account cost updates.

features.title: Bed, Ward & Room Management
features.desc: Interactive bed occupancy map with classifications (standard, private, ICU), patient transfers between rooms and wards, and real-time bed status tracking.

features.title: Patient Accounts & Comprehensive Billing
features.desc: Cumulative patient account covering room charges, procedures, medications, labs, radiology, and consultations, with insurance, corporate accounts, and installment payment plans.

features.title: Inpatient Reports & Analytics
features.desc: Reports on occupancy rates, average length of stay, admission/discharge statistics, and revenue per department, with real-time KPIs for administrative decisions.

steps.title: Admission & Bed Assignment
steps.desc: Patient is admitted and assigned an appropriate bed and ward based on condition and specialty.

steps.title: Treatment & Daily Rounds
steps.desc: Doctor conducts daily rounds, recording medical orders and nursing notes in the electronic file.

steps.title: Cost Accumulation & Services
steps.desc: Every service, medication, and supply is automatically logged to the patient account and linked to insurance.

steps.title: Discharge & Final Settlement
steps.desc: Discharge summary, final financial settlement, and complete medical report are generated.

closingTitle: Ready to Upgrade Your Inpatient Operations?
closingDesc: Speak with our healthcare ERP advisors today and schedule a live walkthrough of the Inpatient & Patient Accounts module.
